sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 59.55% (USD 11.50M cumulative volume) and Lula at 40.50% (USD 11.87M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. The gap between the two is 19.05pp, against 22.40pp in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 17:01 BRT: Lula rose 2.00pp and Flávio Bolsonaro gave up 1.35pp.
sentimento.text2: ⚖️ The two moves are not the same size because the sum of the pair went from 99.40 to 100.05. Normalized, which is the implied probability, each side moved 1.75pp and the gap closed 3.49pp, against 3.35pp raw. A move that survives normalization describes the race; a move that vanishes in it was book spread. ⚠️ Yesterday certified 22.40pp, and the readings recorded that day reached 23.80pp, the widest gap of the 158 days in which the series has both sides, since 14 April 2026, and Flávio Bolsonaro's price today stands 2.15pp below the series high, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.
sentimento.text3: ⭐ On the poll side, the THIRD national survey with fieldwork closing on the same 20/Sep came in. [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), registration BR-06004/2026, 2,004 voters interviewed face to face between 17 and 20/Sep with a 2.0pp margin, released at 18:06 BRT on 21/Sep, puts Lula ahead 37% to 33% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead 42% to 41% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). Together with the other two, the first round comes out Lula +4 at Quaest (face to face), Lula +3 at BTG/Nexus (telephone) and Flávio Bolsonaro +1 at Palver (online): five points of spread between houses that interviewed people up to the same day. 🔴 And the disagreement is wider on the third way: Renan Santos has 11% at Palver and 3% at the other two.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 59.55% in the winner contract (USD 11.50M cumulative volume), down 1.35pp raw and 1.75pp normalized in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, against the one on 21/Sep at 17:01 BRT. His price stands 2.15pp below the series high, 61.70% on 21/Sep. ⚠️ In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he went the other way and ROSE 1.00pp, to 69.50% (USD 1.06M cumulative volume). In the three national polls with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep he leads the first round in one, Palver, by 42% to 41%.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 40.50% in the winner contract (USD 11.87M cumulative volume), up 2.00pp raw and 1.75pp normalized in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: his price stands 27.00pp below the series high, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 6.00pp above the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he rises 0.40pp, to 29.80% (USD 0.89M cumulative volume). On the poll side he leads the first round in two of the three national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE [FIRST-ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT THE DISTANCE BETWEEN RENAN SANTOS AND AUGUSTO CURY SHRANK FOR THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) RUNNING, FROM 5.25pp TO 3.05pp: Renan Santos gives up 3.00pp, to 42.50% (USD 0.39M cumulative volume), the largest fall of the round, and Augusto Cury gives up 0.80pp, to 39.45% (USD 0.27M). Ronaldo Caiado gets no new price, at 15.50% (USD 0.16M), and keeps third place, and Romeu Zema gives up 0.15pp, to 0.35%. Across three confirmed readings the distance between the top two went from 19.95pp to 5.25pp and now to 3.05pp. ⚠️ No price there is an extreme: in the backup Augusto Cury has already been at 60.30% in this same contract, on 04/Sep.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT (17:40 UTC), with the presidential book adding up to USD 153.62M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalized by the sum of the pair, because in a binary contract the sum of the two sides moves on its own and a flat price can hide implied probability that did move.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) FRAUD INQUIRY ON 22/Sep. What stands is still the act of 12/Sep, when Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and the ruling the full court opened on it on 15/Sep was suspended by a request for review from Flávio Dino, with no decision through 22/Sep.
inss.impactoLula: The approval ruler on this panel has a new round: [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, measures 44% approval against 50% disapproval, against 43% to 50% in the same house's previous round. ⚠️ The one-point rise is inside the 2.0pp margin and disapproval did not move. The other three recent readings are from 17/Sep and do not form a series with this one: Datafolha at 48% against 50%, AtlasIntel at 45.4% against 53.6% and Futura/100% Cidades at 44.1% against 53.1%. The spread between houses, 4 points on approval, remains larger than the move of any one of them.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep and 44% against 50% on 21/Sep. The 5-point fall stopped and gave back 1, inside the margin. ⭐ And the performance ruler moved the opposite way in the SAME round: negative rose from 38% to 42%, positive from 32% to 33% and fair fell from 27% to 23%. These are two different questions, approving the president's work and rating the administration, and they neither add up nor cancel out.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is calendar and polling, not an act: there is no new act confirmed by two independent sources in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) fraud inquiry on 22/Sep, the ruling on the suspension that reaches those cases remains stalled on the 15/Sep request for review, and the news is the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) approval round of 21/Sep, in which the house's own downward series stopped.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON 22/Sep THERE WAS NO DECISION ON THE REQUEST TO REVOKE DANIEL VORCARO'S ARREST, filed by his defense on 18/Sep and with Edson Fachin ever since. The ruling on whether to investigate Alexandre de Moraes remains suspended since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for review, which he has not returned.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE NEW ACT OF THE DAY IS ABOUT ASSIGNMENT, NOT MERIT: on 22/Sep Luiz Fux was drawn as rapporteur of a writ of mandamus asking the Senate for the entry and exit records of several people, among them Viviane Barci de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The case was reassigned after Alexandre de Moraes, drawn earlier, declared himself disqualified because it involves his own wife (Metrópoles and Grupo Globo). Before that it had been sent to the 1st Federal Court of Curitiba, which declared itself incompetent because it involves the president of the Senate.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, and stands at 4.30%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, with no new price against the previous day's confirmed reading. AFOS does not attribute this contract's move to coverage of the case: it measures the price and the coverage side by side, each with its own time stamp.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case advances by assignment and by petition, not by decision: the request to revoke the arrest has been with Fachin since 18/Sep with no answer, the ruling on investigating Moraes remains on the 15/Sep request for review, and what changed on 22/Sep was the drawing of Luiz Fux as rapporteur of the Senate records request and the publication of André Mendonça's brief, filed the day before.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on 22/Sep. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On 22/Sep he declared himself disqualified from serving as rapporteur of the writ of mandamus asking the Senate for entry and exit records of several people, among them his own wife, Viviane Barci de Moraes, and the case was reassigned (Metrópoles and Grupo Globo). The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro remains undated, suspended by Flávio Dino's request for review.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 18 he publicly acknowledged having had a meeting with Daniel Vorcaro and said he voted against Banco Master in a case he described as worth up to R$ 145 billion, saying the vote went against the banker (CartaCapital, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). On Sep 14 his office had received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he asked for a review in the ruling on investigating Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case through 22/Sep. On 17/Sep he asked the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) and the securities regulator to look into ties between [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) and a credit dealership.
stf.mendonca: 🔴 HIS BRIEF IS FROM 21/Sep AND THE CONTENT CAME OUT ON 22/Sep, and the two dates are different. On the last day of the deadline set by Fachin he filed 76 pages asking for summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and asking Fachin to consider opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority and false accusation, denying the charges point by point and maintaining the validity of the report on the relationship between Moraes and Vorcaro (Gazeta do Povo, Estadão and Grupo Globo).
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. On 22/Sep what moved was assignment and petition: Luiz Fux drawn as rapporteur of the Senate records request, after Moraes was disqualified, and Mendonça's brief, filed the day before, becoming public. ⚖️ And there is an electoral act of the day, outside the Supreme Court: the Superior Electoral Court accepted the Lula campaign's petition about a network of Instagram profiles said to be boosting content about Flávio Bolsonaro, gave him, Alfredo Gaspar and Mario Frias five days to respond and Meta and Shopee 48 hours to hand over data, without concluding that there was any irregularity (CartaCapital, Poder360 and Grupo Globo).
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 4.30% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, with no new price against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 17:01 BRT. It is a thin book, and the absence of a move there is not the absence of news: the price stands 21.80pp below the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 2.20pp above the low, 2.10% on 08/Jun.
stf.fachin: Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pretrial arrest, with no decision through 22/Sep. It was to him that André Mendonça addressed, on 21/Sep, the request for summary dismissal and the request to investigate Alexandre de Moraes. On 17/Sep, as president of the Court, he pulled from the 23/Sep docket the ruling on the request to investigate Mendonça's conduct as rapporteur of the Master case, without setting a new date.
